text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived. It's an on-campus event 
featuring all kinds of entertainment for 
the fans who always support us.
As for Matikanetannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Knock it out of the park! Ma-Chi-Tan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll hit it, a home run! Mun!
(Whoa...!)

She had been drafted into an inter-class 
sandlot baseball tournament.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Tannhauser-san, just to be sure, do you 
understand the current situation?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Bottom of the 6th, 10-0! We're 
in danger of a mercy rule loss, right?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And right now, there are two outs.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean as long as I hit a home 
run, everything will work out?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That may be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...No, I won't say any more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Our class's fate is in your hands! 
Tannhauser, go knock 'em dead!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aye sir!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The 7th batter is Tannhauser-san. Judging 
by how things have gone so far, it doesn't 
seem like she's particularly good at 
baseball.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However... never holding back no matter 
the opponent, that's what makes a 
first-rate pitch!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Come on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Not quite a home run... but it's a deep 
fly ball!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And I missed the light! Run, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-Whoaaaa~~!!

Machikane Tannhauser takes off running! 
Rounding first, second, and third base, 
she sprints hard for home plate!

However, a powerful throw home from right 
field, who has quickly recovered, is 
closing in fast...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Dive in—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaa!
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Base Umpire
text_block_list.text: Out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Aagh! My hand barely missed touching home 
base!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nyaa~, sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aw man, that's so like Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Still, to score a hit like that under so 
much pressure... That was truly 
impressive.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I really enjoyed the sandlot baseball 
game. You showed so much grit, it was 
super fun~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Even the ending was so like 
Matikanetannhauser-san, it truly warmed my 
heart. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, how embarrassing...

Though she suffered a loss... the fans 
seemed to have thoroughly enjoyed the 
show!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A home run?! You've gotta be kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wha!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, oh, right, I gotta run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay, hooray!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's Tannhauser for ya! You've got some 
serious guts~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Could we actually make a comeback from 
here?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Not bad, Tannhauser-san...!

Just as declared, a home run was hit, 
igniting the team's momentum. However—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, after that, I couldn't score a single 
point.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
King-san flipped a switch, and man, that 
blazing fastball was fast.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still, that home run at the bottom of the 
6th was seriously thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tannhauser-san was so cool, stepping 
up right when it mattered most!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank you very much. Usually, I'm 
at my worst when it matters most, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm glad everyone had a good 
time!”

Though she ended up losing in the end... 
it looked like the fans thoroughly enjoyed 
themselves!
